title: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: Suppose the university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students for its coming edition on the recent development in their hometown.You are now to write an essay for submission. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: Over the past few years, my hometown has undergone remarkable changes. As a student writing for our university newspaper, I would like to share two of them that have impressed me the most: transportation and the environment. In the past, it used to take us hours of bumpy driving to reach the provincial capital. Now, however, a new high-speed railway gets us there in just two hours, and the widened roads have made daily travel far more convenient. Another change worth mentioning is the environment. The small river that once smelled terrible has been cleaned up, and several green parks have been built along its banks, where families now enjoy walking after dinner. All these changes have made my hometown a much better place to live in. As someone who grew up there, I feel truly proud, and I firmly believe that it will become even more beautiful and livable in the years to come.
keyPoints: 总述＋点明投稿身份并预告两点。开头用 Over the past few years, my hometown has undergone remarkable changes 亮出总变化，落实了「亮明总变化」句架；再用 share two of them ... transportation and the environment 预告分点，同时 writing for our university newspaper 点明 投稿身份，扣住 the university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students 的场景。

两组过去→如今→好处的对比。交通用 In the past, it used to ... / Now, however ... 的对比 句架写出高铁与拓路；环境用 Another change worth mentioning is the environment 自然过渡，再 以 once smelled terrible 对 has been cleaned up 形成对比，families now enjoy walking after dinner 给出具体画面，落实了「对比展开」方法。

总评收拢＋自豪展望。用 All these changes have made my hometown a much better place to live in 把两点收拢，再以 I feel truly proud 与 I firmly believe that it will become even more beautiful and livable 抒发自豪并展望，落实「收尾＝总评感受＋展望」，给校报读者一个情感 落点。
